title: BAROMETER ceiling track
description: BAROMETER ceiling track, 5-spots, brass color This brass-colored ceiling track has 5 spots that are easy to direct to get the light exactly where you want it. It goes just as well in the hallway as in the kitchen or living room.
features: Light bulbs sold separately. recommends LED bulb GU10 (5 pcs).
Screws are sold separately. Choose screws which are suitable to the material you are mounting to.
Special waste handling may be required. Please contact your local authorities for more information.
May be completed with other lamps in the same series.
